name: trusty-algebra-tutor
description: Middle school Algebra 1 tutor app modeled on the Algebra 891 classroom (scaffolded lessons, exit tickets, adaptive practice, EN/ES).

scripts.serve: npm run build && npm run start --workspace server
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace server & npm run dev --workspace web & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
